mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_parking_event (event_type, event_name, lot_area, eqpm_id, car_no, event_dt, in_dt, in_eqpm_id, user_name, pass_type, is_cust_def, parking_id, car_image_url, history_id, lpr_trns_id, raw_json) SELECT #{eventType}, #{eventName}, #{lotArea}, #{eqpmId}, #{carNo}, #{eventDt}, #{inDt}, #{inEqpmId}, #{userName}, #{passType}, #{isCustDef}, #{parkingId}, #{carImageUrl}, #{historyId}, #{lprTrnsId}, #{rawJson} WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_parking_event e WHERE e.event_type = #{eventType} AND e.car_no = #{carNo} AND e.event_dt = #{eventDt})

p.event_id, p.event_type, p.event_name, p.lot_area, p.eqpm_id, p.car_no, p.event_dt, p.in_dt, p.in_eqpm_id, p.user_name, p.pass_type, p.is_cust_def, p.parking_id, p.car_image_url, p.reg_dt, car.car_name, car.company_name

FROM tb_parking_event p OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 c.car_name, co.company_name FROM tb_car c LEFT JOIN tb_company co ON co.company_code = c.company_code WHERE c.del_yn = 'N' AND REPLACE(c.car_no, ' ', '') = p.car_no ORDER BY c.car_id DESC ) car
